## Ringkasan / Summary

<!-- Apa yang berubah dan kenapa? / What changed and why? -->

## Jenis perubahan / Type

- [ ] fix  - [ ] feat  - [ ] docs  - [ ] refactor  - [ ] test  - [ ] chore

## Daftar periksa / Checklist

- [ ] `sh tools/hosttest/run.sh` lulus / passes
- [ ] Uji UI / Worker lulus bila terkait / UI / Worker tests pass if relevant
- [ ] `python tools/build_web.py --remote` dijalankan bila `web/` berubah / run if `web/` changed
- [ ] Dokumentasi `docs/id` **dan** `docs/en` diperbarui bila perlu / docs updated in both languages
- [ ] Tidak ada kredensial di diff / no credentials in the diff
- [ ] Perubahan relay/interlock/allowlist disertai uji dan catatan risiko / safety-relevant changes include tests and a risk note
